svg.title: Playing with Fire: stories around the fire
svg.desc: Pixel-art title picture at night. Big pixel letters read Playing with fire, the word fire in flame colours. Below: stories around the fire, and an evening with VAVE. A starry sky with a crescent moon over dark mountains and pines; in front a campfire crackles inside a ring of stones and stumps, and Pix, the little pixel mascot, sits beside it in the warm light.
